kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أبتعث (form VIII)
# أَبْتَعِثُ (ʔabtaʕiṯu) /ʔab.ta.ʕi.θu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# أُبْتَعَثُ (ʔubtaʕaṯu) /ʔub.ta.ʕa.θu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# أَبْتَعِثَ (ʔabtaʕiṯa) /ʔab.ta.ʕi.θa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# أُبْتَعَثَ (ʔubtaʕaṯa) /ʔub.ta.ʕa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
